description: This Dart file defines a Flutter widget for adding or editing a transaction. It contains a StatefulWidget that manages form inputs for amount, note, and date, and provides UI components for user interaction. The widget differentiates between creating a new transaction and editing an existing one based on an optional transaction ID passed via route arguments.
